newsitem.title: UK: Loftus Road appoints temporary chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Loftus Road appoints temporary chief executive.

text.p: Loftus Road Plc, owners of Queens Park Rangers English first division football club and Wasps rugby club, said Charles Levison has been made chief excecutive until a permanent replacement can be found.
Levison will revert to his role as non-executive director once a full time chief executive is appointed.
The two clubs were bought by Chrysalis chairman Chris Wright in June, who unveiled details of the clubs' flotation on the Alternative Investment Market on Wednesday.
Loftus Road, the holding company of the two clubs, is raising 12 million in a 20 million share placing at 72p a share, valuing it at 28.8 million.

The proceeds will be used to repay a four million stg loan from Wright, to buy new players and improve the grounds of both clubs.Loftus Road, a 19,000 all seater stadium in London's Shepherd Bush area, has 8,000 square foot of offices to upgrade to hospitality spaces.

QPR, currently in eighth spot in the first division are keen to win promotion this season. Promotion to the premier league would mean between four and nine million pounds from TV coverage next year, compared with this year's 500,000 stg.
